content_of_post_to_comment: It’s important that you read classic literature and myths and folklore and the great poets because then all their wisdom and weirdness and passion will be rattling around in your head and you will become a poem. YOU are the data center and no one can take that from you.
comment: The idea of becoming a poem raises an interesting question: memory isn't just stored information, but a way of forming patterns and meanings that shape how we see what is possible.
